keywords: ERC-8286 frame 交易模块化账户
summary: chunter-cb 对 EIP-8130 连续提交并合并三项修改：把 owner 改名为 actor，验证接口改为 verifyActor，并加入按 actor 的调用策略与过期时间。ERC-8286 提交，把 ERC-7579 模块化账户接到 EIP-8141 frame 交易的验证流程。隐私原生同质化代币标准（8287）在 ethresear.ch 和 Magicians 同时发帖。当晚 ACDE #238 讨论 Hegotá 非 headliner 候选，包括 EOA 迁移到智能账户的 EIP-7851 与 EIP-8151。

items.topic: EIP-8130：从 owner 到有范围的 actor
items.title: EIP-8130：owner 改名为 actor，并定稿 Transaction Context 命名
items.note: （chunter-cb）提交并合并。理由是很多签名实体只是有范围的凭证（仅 PAYER、仅 SIGNATURE、会话式密钥），叫 owner 夸大了权限；`ownerId`、`OwnerConfig`、`authorizeOwner` 等相应改为 `actorId`、`actor_config`、`authorizeActor` 一类命名。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: rename owner to actor and finalize Transaction Context naming
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), submitted and merged. Many signing entities are scoped credentials (PAYER only, SIGNATURE only, session style keys), so "owner" overstated their authority; `ownerId`, `OwnerConfig`, `authorizeOwner` and similar become `actorId`, `actor_config`, `authorizeActor` and so on.
items.topic_en: EIP-8130: from owner to scoped actor

items.topic: EIP-8130：从 owner 到有范围的 actor
items.title: EIP-8130：`IAccountConfiguration.verify` 改名为 `verifyActor`
items.topic_en: EIP-8130: from owner to scoped actor

items.topic: EIP-8130：从 owner 到有范围的 actor
items.title: EIP-8130：加入 actor 调用策略和按 actor 的过期时间
items.note: 提交并合并。`actor_config` 中的 `policyType` 字节选择可选的调用策略，带签名的 `commitment` 和 `manager` 存在按 `(account, actorId)` 定位的策略槽中。策略在执行时检查而不是在验证时检查，协议判断交易有效性时不读取策略槽，因此策略不进入 mempool 的有效性判断面。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: add actor call policies and per-actor expiry
items.note_en: Submitted and merged. A `policyType` byte in `actor_config` selects an optional call policy, with a signed `commitment` and a `manager` stored in policy slots keyed by `(account, actorId)`. Enforcement happens at execution, not validation: the protocol never reads the policy slots when deciding validity, so policies stay off the mempool validity surface.
items.topic_en: EIP-8130: from owner to scoped actor

items.title: ERC：frame 交易的模块化账户
items.note: （chiranjeev13）提交，Magicians 讨论帖 06:35，即 ERC-8286。它不改动 ERC-7579 的模块结构，只定义 EIP-8141 frame 交易的验证流程：验证器模块返回批准模式，账户在 VERIFY frame 中通过 APPROVE 指令执行它。
items.title_en: ERC: Modular Accounts for Frame Transactions
items.note_en: (chiranjeev13), submitted, with a Magicians thread at 06:35; this is ERC-8286. It leaves the ERC-7579 module structure unchanged and only defines the validation flow for EIP-8141 frame transactions: a validator module returns an approval mode, and the account applies it with the APPROVE instruction during a VERIFY frame.

keywords_en: ERC-8286 modular accounts for frame transactions
summary_en: chunter-cb submitted and merged three EIP-8130 changes: owner is renamed to actor, the verification interface becomes verifyActor, and per-actor call policies and expiry are added. ERC-8286 was submitted, connecting ERC-7579 modular accounts to the EIP-8141 frame transaction validation flow. The privacy-native fungible token standard (8287) was posted on both ethresear.ch and Magicians. In the evening, ACDE #238 discussed Hegotá non-headliner candidates, including EIP-7851 and EIP-8151 for migrating EOAs to smart accounts.
